title: Typing in chat
description: An animated typing badge and nearby 3D hologram panel appear as a player types in chat, without sending the typed text over the network.

title: Inventory open
description: Overhead badge, matching 3D arm pose, and interactive chest hologram showing live cursor position and anonymous slot silhouettes when an inventory is open.

title: Using a crafting table
description: Overhead workstation badge with a 3x3 crafting 3D Holo-Projection and anonymous slot silhouettes for pinging slots in real time.

title: Looking inside a chest
description: Container status badge and 3D chest hologram panel displaying live cursor movement and occupied slot silhouettes without sending item IDs or NBT.

title: AFK with a timer
description: AFK and unfocused badges with elapsed idle time plus an interactive 3D AFK card with a clickable [ Call ] button.

title: In-game settings & live preview
description: Configure scale, opacity, AFK timeout, 3D hologram range/pings, and per-category privacy or visibility switches with a live preview card.
